observations: body L1: the quotation begun on p. 242 goes on: «Alexandriae conditoris».
body L2: Philip Arrhidaeus was the son of Philip II by Philinna of Larissa, Alexander's half-brother on the father's side, not by the same mother as «uterinus» says.
body L3, L10: the dashes after «vocant.» and «(2).» measure 9.6 and 10.2 pt.
body L5: the smooth breathing of «Ἀλεξάνδρου» stands before the capital, as in the notes (L1-L2 of the left column).
body L5-L6: 1 thōth 425 of Nabonassar, 424 × 365 days after 26 February 747 B.C., is 12 November 324 B.C., a Sunday.

body L7-L8, L12-L13, L15-L17: the dashes of «al–Farghānī», «al–Mas‘ūdī», «al–Bīrūnī», «al–Ǵīlī», «al–Battānī», «20–22», «’l–qarnayn», «Āyīn–i–Akbarī», «’l–faẓl», «Al–Battānī» and «’l–qar-» are long dashes (5.0 to 6.0 pt).
body L9-L10: from 12 November 324 B.C. to 1 October 312 B.C. are 4341 days, 11 vague years, 10 months and 26 days.

body L11-L14: from 29 August 324 B.C. to 1 September 312 B.C. are 4386 days, 12 Julian years (4383 days) and 3 days; the 3 days are those by which, after al-Battānī (p. 69, l. 13–14), the Coptic thōth (29 August) precedes the Syrian aylūl (1 September).
body L15: the hyphen at the end of «compo-» (3.0 pt) is set about 5 pt above the baseline.
body L20: «pag. 209, adn. 3» is the note on the Coptic months of p. 209.

body L22-L34: the Memphitic and Theban names are set in a bold Coptic type, the Greek names in a small Greek type with the open theta ϑ; in this type the alpha has an x-like form, close to its kappa (φαωφί, χοϊάκ, φαμενώϑ, φαρμουϑί, παχώμ). «παχώμ» ends in μ (Παχών), as on p. 67; kept as printed. The Theban «ⲙ̄ϣⲓⲣ» has a superlinear stroke over the ⲙ.

body L22-L34: the addenda (Part I, p. LXXIV) refer, for the origin of the names of several Coptic months, to A. Wiedemann, Zu den ägyptischen Monatsnamen, in Orientalistische Litteratur-Zeitung, t. VI, 1903, col. 5–7.

body L6, L23, L25, L29, L33-L34: specks under the s of «dies» (L6), over the second ⲟ of the Theban «ⲑⲟⲟⲩⲧ» (L23), above the a of «atūr» (L25), a mark like a colon after the ⲛ of «ⲫⲁⲙⲉⲛⲱⲑ» (L29), and specks after «efīfī» (L33) and before the Memphitic «ⲙⲉⲥⲱⲣⲏ» (L34) are not transcribed.
notes_left L1-L2: the smooth breathings of «Ἀπὸ» and «Ἀλέ-» stand before the capitals.
notes_left L6: the hyphen of «al-Mas‘ūdī» measures 3.4 pt.
notes_right L2, L4: the sign of equality measures 7.7 pt; the hyphens of «1867-77» and «1873-94» 2.9 and 3.1 pt.
notes_left L8: the note goes on in the right column.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
